# Sabrina Fiechter Photography

## About
Sabrina Fiechter is a portrait photographer based in Zürich, Switzerland, with a studio in Zürich-West (Hardturmstrasse 124a, 8005 Zürich — 8 minutes from Zürich Hauptbahnhof). She specialises in authentic, personal portraits for individuals and businesses. She is also a certified Gallup CliftonStrengths Coach.

## Services

### Bewerbungsfotos (Application Photos / Headshots)
Professional headshots for CVs, LinkedIn and job applications.
- Bewerbungsfoto: CHF 150 — 15-minute studio shoot, 2 retouched images
- Bewerbungsfoto Pro: CHF 220 — 25–30 minute studio shoot, 3 retouched images, 2 outfits
- Gallery delivered within 24 hours, finished images within 3–5 working days
- URL: https://www.sabrinafiechter.ch/bewerbungsfotos/

### Business Portraits
Headshots and portrait series for professionals, teams and personal branding.
- Business Portrait: CHF 220 — individual studio or on-location shoot
- Team Portraits: from CHF 250 base fee + CHF 120 per person
- Personal Branding: CHF 790 — full series telling your professional story
- URL: https://www.sabrinafiechter.ch/business-portraits/

### Portraits (Creative / Personal Portraits)
Personal portraits in any style — calm & timeless, creative & colourful, or outdoors.
- Mini-Session: CHF 190
- Midi-Session: CHF 480
- Maxi-Session: CHF 720
- URL: https://www.sabrinafiechter.ch/portraits/

### Auftragsarbeiten (Commissioned Work)
Custom photography for events, reportages, product photography and individual projects.
- Pricing: custom — contact for a quote
- URL: https://www.sabrinafiechter.ch/auftragsarbeiten/
